The '''Imperial Stock Exchange''' listed all the stock prices and listings for major corporations across the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].

[[Imperial Intelligence]] agent [[Kirtan Loor]] was known to use daily listings from the stock exchange to create his encryption keys.
